title: Inject Path header in reader POST pipeline
description:
## Why
reader run_post_pipeline stores articles to IPFS without a Path header (RFC 5536 §3.1 mandatory). transit prepend_path_header adds Path only at transit ingestion time, not at reader POST time.

## What
1. Add hostname: String field to ReaderConfig (default to system hostname or 'localhost')
2. In run_post_pipeline, call prepend_path_header (or equivalent) before sign_article so the signed article includes Path:
3. Update tests to verify Path header present in stored article

## Acceptance
- Article stored via reader POST contains Path header
- Path header is covered by operator signature
- Config migration: hostname optional with sane default
